rationale: B shows multiple self-initiated, sensible shifts of focus and behavior: from people to toys (t42 PLAY_CUBE, t54 PLAY_CHIME, t66 PLAY_CUBE again, t94 PLAY_BALL) and play-bow sequences (t42–43, t78–83) without new inputs, plus a brief vocalization (t18). B responds coherently to inputs: TOUCH (t8), OFFER_FOOD (t32), PRESENT_OBJECT (t44), and STARTLE (t68) with withdrawal then resuming play (t78). In contrast, A fixates on PLAY_BALL early, responds to TOUCH (t8), OFFER_FOOD (t32), and STARTLE (t68), but ignores CALL (t20) and PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t44), and spends long periods with attention NONE after t40 with little new initiative. Overall, B exhibits stronger autonomy, adaptability, and coherent ongoing activity across the timeline.
